symptom: Under slow database reads, a source re-verification exceeded its 5 s wait (`github_verification_busy`/`expired`). The relay's non-admission re-check then revoked the whole room, and the user's bridge and every client dropped mid-session on Alpha.
rule: A temporary verification failure keeps an already-authorized room only until the source authority's original absolute grace deadline, under the same proof, with a bounded retry. Revocations, changed proofs or source revisions, admission and app/session reads stay fresh (principles 4, 9, 11).
